what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In person at the Lunenburg Middle/High School Auditorium; the meeting will not be recorded or live-streamed.

items.agenda_line: Discussion on November 17, 2026 Special Town Meeting and Warrant Articles
items.why_it_matters: The board may discuss the warrant articles for the Special Town Meeting held the same day.

items.agenda_line: o Potential Votes on Deferred Warrant Articles
items.why_it_matters: The board may vote on warrant articles that were deferred, so residents can learn where the board stands on them.

preview.hook: Special Town Meeting warrant articles and possible votes on deferred articles
preview.one_line: Select Board, Nov 17, 6:30 PM at the Middle/High School Auditorium: discussion of the Special Town Meeting warrant articles and possible votes on deferred articles. Not recorded.
